# Roadmap Summary

| Theme                  | Tranche 1 | Tranche 2           |
| ---------------------- | --------- | ------------------- |
| Workflow Architecture  | ✅         | Enhancement         |
| Data Harmonisation     | ✅         | Enhancement         |
| Workflow Catalogue     | Planning  | ✅                   |
| Dashboard              | Planning  | ✅                   |
| Training               | Initial   | Expanded            |
| FAIR & PID             | Initial   | Full implementation |
| Vocabulary Integration | Initial   | Full integration    |


The project already defines:

* **WP3** Data and Metadata
* **WP4.1** First tranche workflow functionality (May–Nov 2026)
* **WP4.2** Second tranche workflow functionality (Jan–Nov 2027)
* **WP5** Workflow Catalogue and Dashboard
* **WP6** Training, community building, workshops and user stories 



## Linking Use Cases to Roadmap Priorities

| Use Case                                    | Main User Groups | Tranche 1 (Year 1)            | Tranche 2 (Year 2)                   |
| ------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| UC01 Develop new ecosystem indicator        | UG01, UG02, UG03 | ✅ Core priority               | Enhancement and expansion            |
| UC02 Adapt workflow to new ecosystem        | UG01, UG03       | ✅ Core priority               | Improved tooling                     |
| UC03 State of Environment reporting         | UG06             | ✅ Basic outputs               | Catalogue integration                |
| UC04 Ecosystem accounting                   | UG06             | Partial support               | ✅ Priority expansion                 |
| UC05 Environmental management               | UG05             | ✅ Demonstration workflows     | Expanded ecosystem coverage          |
| UC06 Integrate heterogeneous datasets       | UG03, UG04       | ✅ Initial harmonisation tools | Improved templates and automation    |
| UC07 Publish FAIR workflows                 | UG02, UG09       | ✅ Core requirement            | Enhanced FAIR and PID implementation |
| UC08 Discover and reuse workflows           | UG01, UG03, UG08 | Limited documentation         | ✅ Workflow catalogue                 |
| UC09 Training and skills development        | UG08             | Initial guides                | ✅ Full training program              |
| UC10 Nature-related reporting and assurance | UG07             | Initial use cases             | ✅ Expanded support                   |

This mapping aligns directly with the project's intended outcomes around modular workflows, FAIR workflows, interoperability, workflow catalogues and community adoption.
